acoes.alvo:
if not (application "Spotify" is running) then
	tell application "Spotify" to activate
	repeat 40 times
		delay 0.25
		if application "Spotify" is running then exit repeat
	end repeat
end if
repeat 12 times
	try
		tell application "Spotify"
			activate
			play track "spotify:track:2zYzyRzz6pRmhPzyfMEC8s"
		end tell
		exit repeat
	on error
		delay 0.5
	end try
end repeat
if application "Spotify" is running then tell application "Spotify" to playpause
if application "Spotify" is running then tell application "Spotify" to next track
